first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: A backward-leaning person with short black hair and dark glasses, wearing an open black long coat, a close-fitting dark top, black pants, and knee-high black boots, with harness straps around the waist and thighs.

entities.name: rooftop surface
entities.identification: The flat grayish-brown paved surface below Person B, with straight seams between slabs visible in places.

entities.name: low rooftop wall
entities.identification: The low, light gray-beige wall in the upper part of the image at the beginning, with straight edges, corners, and faces of differing lightness.

entities.name: smoke
entities.identification: The expanses of white-gray smoke behind Person B, uneven in density and with soft, diffuse edges.

entities.name: distant city buildings
entities.identification: The gray buildings revealed through gaps in the smoke in the later portion, some of which have repeated horizontal light and dark bands.

entities.name: projectile
entities.identification: The small dark projectile visible near the trajectory, appearing in the final portion as a blurry small dot separated from Person B's outline.

entities.name: translucent ring-shaped disturbance
entities.identification: The gray-green translucent ring-shaped ripples arranged along an airborne path near Person B's upper body, locally distorting the background and clothing outlines.

entities.name: sky
entities.identification: The light gray, low-texture area of sky above the buildings in the later portion.
